blocks.title: Operators aur expressions
blocks.text: Operators woh alamaat hain jo variables aur qeematon par amal karti hain. Expression variables, operators aur qeematon ka aisa mel hai jo nateeja deta hai.
Python mein arithmetic, comparison, assignment aur logical operators hain, aur precedence ke qawaid tay karte hain ke expression mein kaunsa amal pehle hoga.

blocks.explanation: Expression: + operator hai, 3 aur 4 qeematein, aur mil kar nateeja 7 dete hain.

items: Operators qeematon par amal karte hain; expressions unhein mila kar nateeja dete hain; chaar khandan: arithmetic, comparison, assignment, logical.
